Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G4417; not stumbling, i.e. (figuratively) without sin:--from falling.
BiblicalUsage: Jude closes by praising Him who is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before His glory with exceeding joy. The word is not stumbling, kept steady on feet that would fall on their own.
TheologicalSignificance: We do not keep ourselves from falling; He keeps us, and that is the whole hope of the verse.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
